h:
虽然这不是真正的修复，但结果并没有什么不同。

下载并测试此工作流程。您可以通过标记图像或提示默认 Kontext 行为进行编辑来进行修复。

现在，在版本 2 中

我添加了一个外画功能。如果图像的其余部分有太多明显的黑色区域，它可能并不总是有效。然而，它运作良好，我鼓励您尝试一下这个工作流程。

o.en:
Although this is not a real inpaint, But the results are no different.

Download and test this workflow. You can do inpaint by marking image or prompt for edit by default Kontext behavior.

Now, in version 2

I have added an outpaint feature. It may not always work if there are too many obvious black areas in the rest of the image. However, it works well and I encourage you to give this workflow a try.
